Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add it to a bowl with lime juice, avocado oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Heat a large pan on medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and fully cooked to 165°F. 3. Drain the canned corn really well and pat it dry with paper towel. In the same pan or a clean hot pan, add the corn in a single layer and let it sit untouched for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until charred in spots. 4. In a bowl, mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt, and black pepper until smooth. 5. In a large bowl, add the charred corn, red onion, red bell pepper, cilantro, jalapeños, and cotija cheese. 6. Pour in the sauce and mix everything until coated. 7. Divide the chicken and street corn salad mixture into 4 servings. Store chilled and eat within 3 to 4 days. Honey Chipotle Chicken Wraps✨🌯🌶️ #cookingtips #recipeideas #easyrecipes #mealprep #DinnerIdeas Recipe:  Ingredients- Honey Chipotle Chicken * 4-5boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced * 2 dollops Greek yogurt * 2 tbsp chipotle peppers in adobo sauce (blended until smooth) * Olive oil or avocado oil * 3–4 cloves garlic, minced * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Paprika * Chili powder * Cumin * Salt & pepper * Chicken bouillon * Honey (for drizzling) Homemade French Fries * 2 russet potatoes, sliced into fries * Olive oil * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Paprika Creamy Chipotle Sauce * ½ cup mayonnaise * 2–3 tbsp chipotle peppers in adobo sauce * Garlic powder * Juice of 1 lime * Black pepper, paprika, salt  For the Wraps * Large flour tortillas * Chopped romaine lettuce * Red onion, diced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Fresh cilantro, minced * Prepared chipotle sauce Instructions 1. Prepare the chicken: Dice your chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces. In a bowl, combine Greek yogurt, blended chipotle adobo peppers, a drizzle of olive oil or avocado oil, minced garlic, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, chili powder, cumin, salt, pepper, and chicken bouillon. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken: Heat a pan with oil over medium-high heat. Add your chicken and sear until nicely browned and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. 3. Add the honey: Once the chicken is fully cooked, drizzle honey over the top and toss until it coats the chicken and thickens into a sticky glaze. Remove from the pan and set aside. 4. Make the fries: Slice your russet potatoes into fries and spread them onto a sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Bake at 425°F for 40–45 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crispy. 5. Make the chipotle sauce: In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, chipotle adobo peppers, garlic powder, freshly squeezed lime juice, and black pepper. Mix until smooth and creamy. 6. Assemble your wraps: Spread a generous amount of chipotle sauce onto a large tortilla. Add chopped romaine lettuce, honey chipotle chicken, diced red onion, red and orange bell peppers, and fresh cilantro. 7. Fold and sear: Fold your tortilla into a wrap, then place it seam-side down in a lightly oiled pan. Sear until golden and crispy on both sides. 8. Serve: Wrap in parchment paper, slice in half, and serve with your homemade fries. Drizzle extra chipotle sauce over the top or serve it on the side for dipping!
